newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Mimes to ridicule jaywalkers in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Mimes to ridicule jaywalkers in Colombia.

text.p: Under a new programme to improve traffic safety in downtown Bogota, jaywalkers will be pulled over and publicly ridiculed by white-faced mime artists, according to a report on Sunday.

The ridiculing mimes, part of the strategy introduced by eccentric city mayor Antanas Mockus, will be introduced along with an advertising campaign that will categorize bad drivers as different barnyard animals, Colombia's leading daily El Tiempo reported.

The TV and radio spots, sponsored by the Transit and Transport Ministry and beginning on Thursday, classifies the classic road hog as a driver who ignores all traffic signs and goes the wrong way down one-way streets.
Donkeys are typified as motorists with little sense of direction, who stop in the middle of the highway to find their way and are subject to violent outbursts if pulled over for a traffic violation.

The title of cow is reserved mostly for the capital's kamikaze bus drivers who follow fixed routes but have no specific stopping points, leading them to weave in and out of other vehicles in search of passengers like their farm counterparts looking for a juicy patch of grass.

The striking campaign shows the daily nightmare of motoring down the Colombian capital's streets, besieged by temper-rousing traffic-jams and would-be race car drivers, and combines commentary with the appropriate animal noises to shame motorists into being more considerate.
